findings.title: hostPath does not exist on the node
findings.cause: volume docker mounts the Docker socket /var/run/docker.sock, and node kd-faults-control-plane runs containerd://2.3.4, not Docker, so there is no such socket and the pod cannot start; Deployment image-builder has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "docker" : hostPath type check failed, /var/run/docker.sock is not a socket file, unable to determine its type: path "/var/run/docker.sock" does not exist

findings.fix: Talk to the node's runtime through its own socket (/run/containerd/containerd.sock for containerd, with a client such as crictl or nerdctl), or, to build images, use a builder that needs no daemon (BuildKit rootless, kaniko, buildah); Kubernetes has not run on Docker Engine since 1.24 unless cri-dockerd was installed.
